Hi Bethany / Team,

Following up with this week's Mutual Action Plan checkpoint focused on dedicated/private capacity sizing. Attached is the latest MAP workbook (helix_map_v3.xlsx) and a quick GPU diagram (gpu_sizing_diagram.png). Key items below — looking for confirmation or edits by EOD Wednesday so we can lock the canary configuration for the pilot.

Summary (current ask):
- Use-case: inference for clinical-document summarization and search re-ranking (mixed workloads).
- Target start: pilot canary 2026-04-01; ramp to production by 2026-06-01.
- Proposed primary regions: us-west-2 (pilot), eu-central-1 (secondary), us-east-1 (fallback for burst).

Proposed dedicated/private sizing (initial proposal):
- us-west-2 (pilot): 4 x H100 (80GB) nodes, 16 concurrent model shards, target steady-state throughput 40–60 requests/sec (avg payload ~800 tokens).
- eu-central-1: 2 x A100-80GB nodes, 8 shards, target 20–30 req/sec.
- us-east-1: reserved 2xA100 for burst/failover; no steady traffic initially.

Latency/throughput targets:
- P95 generation latency target: <= 350ms for short prompts (<=256 tokens), <= 1.2s for long requests (>=1024 tokens).
- Throughput target is per-cluster; we will shard model replicas and use batching/caching to smooth bursts.

Open questions / decisions needed:
1) Confirm preferred GPU family for pilot (H100 vs A100) in us-west-2.
2) Agree on acceptance thresholds (latency / error rate / cost) for canary.
3) Finalize network/VPC peering and KMS requirements for private deployment.

Action items (owners):
- Laura: finalize SOW draft and updated MAP worksheet (attached) — due Wed 03/04.
- Rishi: provide exact memory/kv-cache sizing and expected token cost delta for H100 vs A100 — due Tue 03/03.
- Markus: confirm procurement/quotas for H100 in us-west-2 and propose fallback nodes — due Fri 03/06.
- Bethany: confirm internal compliance checklist and any additional logging/retention needs — due Wed 03/04.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync (Tue 03/03 or Wed 03/04). I can send calendar times once I get your availability.

Thanks — Laura

Quick infra input after reviewing the MAP workbook and discussing with runtime team:

- Throughput semantics: the 40–60 req/sec number Laura listed is per-cluster steady-state. With intelligent sharding and KV/prefix caching we expect effective user-facing throughput to increase ~1.6x versus raw single-replica throughput for short prompts.
- H100 vs A100: for mixed-length workloads we recommend H100 for pilot in us-west-2 due to better fp16/ampere throughput at higher concurrency. Expected P95 (>=1024 tokens) on H100: ~800–950ms with continuous batching; on A100: ~1.1–1.4s under similar batching policies. Token-cost delta: estimate +18–24% on H100 vs A100 for identical accuracy (we trade cost for latency). I'll put a short table into the MAP workbook.
- Memory/kv-cache: plan for 48–56GB usable KV cache per shard for the long-context workloads; this influences shard count.

Updated action items / owners (small changes):
- Rishi: add performance table (H100 vs A100) into helix_map_v3.xlsx and include token-cost delta — due Tue 03/03 EOD.
- Markus: check H100 availability & training procurement timeline (if any) and confirm quotas — due Fri 03/06.
- Monica: draft a minimal acceptance test plan for canary (latency/accuracy/error-rate) — due Wed 03/04.

-Rishi

Canary config (agreed):
- us-west-2 (pilot): 4 x H100 (80GB) nodes; model sharding to 16 replicas; target steady-state throughput 50 req/sec; nightly batch windows will be routed to a scaled pool; target P95 (short): <=320ms, P95 (>=1024 tokens): ~850–950ms.
